newsitem.title: USA: TriNet to post $6 mln gain from stores sale.
newsitem.headline: TriNet to post $6 mln gain from stores sale.

text.p: TriNet Corporate Realty Trust Inc said it completed the sale of 34 retail stores for a price of $25.1 million, and will post a fourth quarter gain of about $6 million from the deal.
TriNet said it plans to use the proceeds to pay down its revolving credit facility, and to fund the purchase of office and industrial properties.
TriNet said the deal was part of a strategy of de-emphasizing retail property holdings, and focusing acquisitions on the office and industrial real estate sectors.
The nine-state retail-store portfolio comprises 408,586 square feet and is net leased to REX Stores Corp, a consumer electronics retailer.

TriNet said that after the deal, retail property holdings account for five percent of current annualized rental revenues. TriNet's portfolio now includes 76 properties, comprising more than 13 million square feet in 23 states.

TriNet is a real estate investment trust that acquires, owns and manages predominantly office and industrial properties, net leased to corporations nationwide, including corporate headquarters and strategically important distribution facilities.
